_comment: sci-toolkit skill catalog — SSOT for the selective installer (install/install.py). 'requires' = hard deps the installer MUST auto-pull; deps extracted from each SKILL.md, not guessed. No circular dependencies. 'groups' = top-level buckets that categories roll up into; 'size_kb' measured from disk (du), used by the installer to show install footprint.  | docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx are Anthropic-owned skills and are not bundled in this repo (external=true). Their dependency entries are kept; the installer skips them and only prints guidance.

groups.research: Research work (skills) — papers, literature, experiments, data, figures, documents, validation
groups.connect: External integrations (connectors) — mail, GitHub, Asana, Notion (draft-first)

connectors._note: External service connectors — scripts/connectors/. Unlike skills, these require credentials.json, and are draft-first/write-guarded. On install, copy scripts/connectors/ as a whole (they share the common _credentials.py).

mail.role: Mail draft-first (IMAP read + SMTP draft, triple-gated send)

github.role: Issue/PR lookup + PR draft-only + upstream fork-guard

asana.role: Tasks, comments, subtasks (auto format validation, write-guard)

calendar.role: Google Calendar event lookup + creation (attendees = outward warning, no edit/delete)
calendar.needs: Google OAuth client + token (one-time browser consent)

sheets.role: Google Sheets value lookup + row append (append-only, existing cells untouched)
sheets.needs: Google OAuth client + token (one-time browser consent)

manuscript-pipeline.role: Manuscript draft -> write -> self-review -> proof (IMRAD, journal-specific formats)

patent-invention-disclosure.role: Manuscript -> Korean patent invention disclosure (발명내용설명서) for attorney review

endnote-citation-injection.role: Bulk EndNote citation insertion + dual DOI verification

academic-term-rules.role: Academic term/notation rules SSOT (species-name italics, units, kinetics)

scientific-validation.role: Scientific plausibility gate for fit/optimization results (5 axes)

literature-review.role: Systematic literature review document generation (PRISMA, verified citations, PDF)

research-lookup.role: Free API lookups (auto-routes between OpenAlex + PubMed)

biorxiv-database.role: Preprint search (bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, no key required)

openalex-database.role: Query and bibliometric analysis over OpenAlex's 240M+ papers

paper-extract.role: Extract tables/figures/body text from a paper PDF/docx

primer-design.role: Primer design (iPCR, RE cloning, expression check, order sheets)

lab-data-analysis.role: Lab data EDA (kinetic, HPLC, gel, MSDS/GHS)

data-quality-checks.role: Pre-analysis raw-table structure check (6 axes: completeness, uniqueness, validity, consistency, accuracy, timeliness)

analysis-code-testing.role: pytest testing for analysis code (known-answer/golden-file regression, tolerance, seed reproducibility)

stats-workflow.role: 3-stage statistics workflow (explore -> test + check assumptions -> APA reporting)

docx.role: Word document creation/editing (structure validation, tracked changes, equations)  * Anthropic-provided skill -- cannot be redistributed under license. Fetch and install it in your own Claude Code environment (see docs/12).

xlsx.role: Excel creation/editing (formulas, recalculation, error scanning)  * Anthropic-provided skill -- cannot be redistributed under license. Fetch and install it in your own Claude Code environment (see docs/12).

pdf.role: PDF manipulation (merge, split, forms, OCR)  * Anthropic-provided skill -- cannot be redistributed under license. Fetch and install it in your own Claude Code environment (see docs/12).

pptx.role: Presentation (.pptx) creation/reading/editing -- slides/notes/templates  * Anthropic-provided skill -- cannot be redistributed under license. Fetch and install it in your own Claude Code environment (see docs/12).

journal-presentation-maker.role: Automated journal club / lab meeting presentation authoring and review

markdown-mermaid-writing.role: Mermaid diagram standard -- prefer structure/flow diagrams

generate-image.role: General-purpose image generation/editing (AI) -- photos, illustration, concept art

code-quality.role: SOLID principles, file-size limits, systematic refactoring gate (review split into Standards/Spec axes)

spec-first-development.role: Design/spec/implementation plan before code -- 3-path classification (spike/bounded/architectural), approval gate, no placeholders, self-review

test-first-development.role: Write a failing test first -- red-green-refactor, test kinds for numerical research code (known-answer, analytic limit, conservation, regression), blocks rationalization

spec-driven-research-dev.role: 4-stage spec workflow for a new pipeline/module rewrite (specify -> plan -> tasks -> implement)

avoid-ai-writing.role: Detect/fix AI-writing tells (em-dash, cliches, template phrasing) -- final check for manuscripts, mail, reports. Korean-language tells (translationese, ending-rhythm patterns, bound nouns) are detected via the korean-tells.md supplementary catalog

conda-env-manager.role: conda environment diagnosis, creation, repair, import scanning, version-conflict resolution

compat-check.role: pre-install compatibility probe (real dry-run install in a disposable venv, uv preferred / pip fallback) for a GitHub repo or PyPI package, before installing it for real

experiment-hub.role: Experiment protocols, condition optimization, history logging, experiment comparison

get-available-resources.role: Detect CPU/GPU/memory/disk -- decide strategy before heavy computation

git-workflow-manager.role: git workflow -- enforced pull, temp-file cleanup, commit rules

skill-developer.role: Guide for writing a new skill and setting up triggers

token-efficient-routing.role: Agent/model routing -- assigns work to the cheapest adequate tier (3 gates: spawn, tier, structure; gate-hook patterns; log-based tuning)

web-scraping.role: Web crawling, academic metadata (Crossref/arXiv/bioRxiv), bulk PDF harvesting

test-quality.role: Test quality -- 3 ways a passing test verifies nothing (recomputes the expected value the same way the implementation does, is coupled to internals, or was mass-written up front) plus seam selection

debugging-loop.role: Bug-diagnosis loop -- get a red-capable repro loop before forming a hypothesis (reproduce, minimize, falsifiable hypothesis, regression test)

paper-writing.label: Paper writing
paper-writing.desc: From manuscript draft through proofing, citations, and peer review

molbio.label: Molecular biology experiments
molbio.desc: Primer design, sequence analysis, bioinformatics databases

data-figures.label: Data analysis & figures
data-figures.desc: Data EDA -> statistics -> publication figures -> plausibility validation

documents.label: Document work
documents.desc: Working with Word, Excel, PDF, and Markdown files
